$comment: Verified NZ council water-leak reporting channels (issue #34). Keys are Stats NZ territorial-authority names matching councils.name. emails -> council_zones.alert_emails (send target); entity/phone/form_url/app -> councils columns. form_url stays null where the issue verified no canonical URL.

Wellington City.notes: 0800 TIAKI WAI, urgent. Tiaki Wai takes over Wellington metro water services from 1 Jul 2026 (successor to Wellington Water); legacy Wellington Water mailbox — confirm the Tiaki Wai equivalent.

Porirua City.notes: 24/7 line. Photos go by separate email attached to the service request. Also MyPorirua portal.

Auckland.notes: Press 1 for faults; free text 3130; LiveChat on watercare.co.nz. Genuine dedicated faults mailbox. SMS 3130 confirmed on Auckland Council's flooding-report page and the NZ SMS shortcode directory (#35).

Hamilton City.notes: Call immediately if gushing. 'Report a water leak' online form also available.

Tauranga City.notes: 24/7 line. Online 'Report a water problem' form also available.

Dunedin City.notes: 24/7 urgent line. 'Fix it' online form (water leaking category) also available.
